auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Consensus API key sent with the x-api-key header. Manage API access at https://consensus.app/home/api/.

actions.name: search_papers
actions.description: Search Consensus for relevance-ranked academic papers with publication, study, and quality filters.

query.description: The research question or topic to search for.

year_min.description: Exclude papers published before this year.

year_max.description: Exclude papers published after this year.

month_min.description: A month number used to limit the publication window.

month_max.description: A month number used to limit the publication window.

study_types.description: A list of documented Consensus filter values.

human.description: Whether to include only studies involving humans.

controlled.description: Whether to include only controlled studies.

sample_size_min.description: Exclude studies with a smaller sample size.

sjr_min.description: An SJR journal quartile where 1 is the highest-quality quartile and 4 is the lowest.

sjr_max.description: An SJR journal quartile where 1 is the highest-quality quartile and 4 is the lowest.

duration_min.description: The minimum study duration in days.

duration_max.description: The maximum study duration in days.

open_access.description: Whether to include only open-access papers.

publisher_name.description: A list of documented Consensus filter values.

domain.description: A list of documented Consensus filter values.

country.description: A list of documented Consensus filter values.

journal_name.description: A preferred journal name used to rank matching journals higher.

clinical_guideline.description: Whether to include only clinical guidelines.

medical_mode.description: Whether to focus the search on top medical journals and clinical guidelines.

include_semantic_score.description: Whether to include Consensus semantic relevance scores in results.

include_full_text_chunks.description: Whether to include query-relevant licensed full-text excerpts when the plan supports them.

page.description: The zero-indexed result page, up to page 49.

page_size.description: The requested number of papers; Consensus caps it to the current plan maximum.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for searching Consensus papers.

citation_count.description: The number of citations reported by Consensus.

anyOf.description: The detected study design when available.

study_type.description: The detected study design when available.

anyOf.description: The study sample size when available.

sample_size.description: The study sample size when available.

anyOf.description: The best SJR quartile reported for the journal when available.

sjr_best_quartile.description: The best SJR quartile reported for the journal when available.

anyOf.description: The plain-language key takeaway when available.

takeaway.description: The plain-language key takeaway when available.

url.description: The Consensus URL for the paper.

items.description: A research paper returned by Consensus.

results.description: The relevance-ranked papers returned for the query.

page.description: The zero-indexed page returned by Consensus.

page_size.description: The result count limit applied by Consensus.

is_end.description: Whether this is the final page of results.

anyOf.description: The next page number, or null at the end.

next_page.description: The next page number, or null at the end.

outputSchema.description: The paginated paper search response returned by Consensus.
